segments.text: I want to apply for a job at the bakery.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker expresses their wish to apply for an open position at a bakery.
The listener enthusiastically agrees with the speaker's plan.

segments.text: Are you afraid of the interview? A little.
segments.englishExplanation: One person asks if the interview causes fear, and the other admits to feeling slightly nervous.

segments.text: I am not good at talking. Don't worry.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker admits they lack confidence in speaking, and their friend tells them to stay calm.

segments.text: I will help you. Best wishes.
segments.englishExplanation: The friend promises to offer assistance and shares supportive words.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to describe skill or ability in doing an activity. The preposition 'at' is followed by a gerund (-ing form).
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir eylemi yapmakta başarılı ya da yetenekli olduğunu ifade etmek için 'be good at' kalıbının ardına fiile '-ing' takısı eklenerek kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: She is very good at baking cakes.

quiz.question: In segment 4, what does the speaker mean by "I am not good at talking"?

options.text: They feel nervous and lack confidence when speaking.
They refuse to answer any questions at work.
They have lost their voice and cannot talk.
They do not understand the language of the interview.
